narration: Six people are stranded in a failing capsule. The rescue ship's sensors are dark.
visual_cue: Radar sweep finds six life signs; SignalLost wordmark resolves.

narration: SignalLost is a rescue game for a Twitch stream. The streamer flies the ship. The audience sees what the pilot cannot.
visual_cue: Real landing page; then the pilot's limits and the crew's scans side by side, the one safe sector highlighted.

narration: One Node server runs the mission and sends each screen only what its role allows. Viewers receive the intel. The cockpit and the stream overlay never do.
visual_cue: Mission engine diagram; state packets to all three screens, intel packets only to the crew.

narration: Every system splits the evidence. The pilot knows the hull's limits; chat holds the scans.
visual_cue: Crew proposes the safe sector; pilot sets course and the corridor clears.

narration: Engineers reason through four wiring rules that allow exactly one answer.
visual_cue: Crew reads the wiring rules and proposes relays; pilot flips them and engages power.

narration: Chat decodes the symbols, but the order to send them appears only in the cockpit.
visual_cue: Crew maps bands to symbols; pilot enters them in transmission order and transmits.

narration: The final approach is flown by hand against ion drift.
visual_cue: Crew sees the safe lane; pilot steers, engages the tractor beam.

narration: Any viewer can send boost to steady the ship for six seconds: one cell each, three per mission.
visual_cue: Boost lands; stabilization countdown; recovery climbs (sped up 2.4×) to the debrief.

narration: Live chat reaches the server through Twitch EventSub, with a read-only scope. Messages are de-duplicated, parsed into commands, and survive reconnects.
visual_cue: A !boost message travels OAuth → EventSub → de-duplication → parser → engine.

narration: Everything shown is the real app in training mode, with a simulated crew. Forty-two automated tests cover the rules; real chat is proven only on stream.
visual_cue: Synthetic validation versus real-world validation, side by side.

narration: Six lives. One pilot. A whole crew.
visual_cue: End card: wordmark, live URL and repository.
